title: AL Language extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central version 15.0.1433841 (New version)
summary: The AL Language extension version 15.0 introduces implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef, HTTP mocking for testing, improved JSON data access methods, multiline strings, a continue statement for loops, and numerous other developer features. This update helps developers write more flexible, testable, and maintainable AL code with enhanced language constructs and APIs.
key_points: Implicit conversion between Record and RecordRef types allows direct assignment without explicit method calls
HttpClientHandler enables mocking HTTP responses in test codeunits with configurable request policies for OnPrem instances
New JSON access methods (GetBoolean, GetInteger, GetText, etc.) simplify data retrieval without always using JsonToken
Language enhancements include multiline strings with @ prefix, continue statement for loops, and UserControlHost page type
Multiple developer experience improvements in VS Code including searchable downloaded symbols, new project templates, and file preview functionality
features: Downloaded symbol search in Copilot Chat

quotes.text: Every HTTP request that occurs during the execution of that test will be intercepted and routed to the handler.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core mechanism of HTTP mocking for controlled testing of external service integrations

quotes.text: AL now has support for multiline string literals. A multiline string must be prefixed with @.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces a new language syntax that simplifies handling of multi-line text content in code

quotes.text: From runtime version 15, it is possible to use the continue keyword in loops to continue to the next iteration.
quotes.why_it_matters: Adds a standard loop control feature that developers expect from modern programming languages
